issues.title: External Reference Path Drift
issues.why: The overview (00-overview.md) and foundation (01-foundation-and-architecture.md) reference '../02-coding-guidelines/01-cross-language/04-code-style/00-overview.md', but the consistency report (§2.2) admits historical drift and the provided context does not include the target file to verify resolution.
issues.fix: Ensure all external paths in 01-foundation-and-architecture.md match the current on-disk structure of spec/02.

issues.title: Concurrency Implementation Prose Gap
issues.why: AC-11 mandates specific flock() usage for FileLogger, but the actual FileLogger spec (04-logging-and-error-handling.md) is mentioned as having a 'prose-mirror gap' in the changelog, potentially leading to implementation without locks if the coder skips the AC file.
issues.fix: Explicitly inline the flock(LOCK_EX) requirement into the normative blockquote of 04-logging-and-error-handling.md §4.3.

issues.title: Filename Casing Inconsistency
issues.why: The spec contains references to 'CHANGELOG.md' (uppercase) in 10-deployment-patterns.md while the project standard is lowercase 'changelog.md', creating ambiguity for case-sensitive filesystems.
issues.fix: Run sed -i 's/CHANGELOG\.md/changelog.md/g' on all files in spec/18/.
